text: {"lessons":["A winning position can be trimmed to manage risk, but I should base the decision on my overall plan rather than simply locking in gains.","Selling Stock A and Stock E at a profit does not prove they were mistakes or that selling was optimal; I should avoid letting pride or regret drive future trades.","Past price movements do not predict future returns, so I should make each month's decisions using current conditions and disciplined position sizing."]}
